proof_body:
by
  intro R M₁ M₂ M₃ N₁ N₂ N₃ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f₁ f₂ g₁ i₁ i₂ h1 hf hg x hx hfx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (hf x).1 hfx
  refine ⟨y, hg ?_, rfl⟩
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
  rw [this, hx, map_zero]
